extracted.name: Puto Cheese
extracted.description: My youngest's favorite sweets specially with lots of cheddar cheese on top. Easy to prepare, quick to cook and serve.
instruction_lines: Combine all dry ingredients in a bowl.
Add all wet ingredients and mix well.
Pour in the mold and put cheese toppings.
Grease the mold and steam for 10 minutes.
